channel.title: AI Builder's Field Guide — Recently Added
channel.description: A daily-curated wiki of the tools, models, and patterns that AI power-users and builders actually reach for.

item.title: Perplexity AI
item.description: Perplexity AI is a conversational answer engine that provides real-time cited search, advanced deep research, and connectors for live context from various applications. — It offers a comprehensive research platform with verifiable sources and the ability to integrate live data, distinguishing it from traditional search engines by focusing on actionable intelligence.

item.title: Google Pics
item.description: Google Pics is a new AI tool for creating and editing images directly within Google Workspace using text prompts. — This tool provides prompt-based image generation and refinement integrated into productivity applications, offering an AI-first approach to design.

item.title: VoiceStudio
item.description: VoiceStudio is an open-source, local-first platform offering voice cloning, design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription, and audiobook creation. — It provides a self-hosted and open-source alternative to commercial speech synthesis services like ElevenLabs, giving builders more control and flexibility over their audio generation workflows.

item.title: Utopia
item.description: Utopia is a local-first, agent-assisted workbench that transforms documents into ontologies for structured knowledge representation. — It enables agents to build and query structured knowledge graphs from unstructured documents, enhancing their long-term memory and reasoning capabilities within the Model Context Protocol ecosystem.

item.title: Scientific Agent Skills
item.description: This GitHub repository provides a library of 163 pre-built research skills for AI agents, covering scientific domains like biology, chemistry, and medicine. — It offers a standardized and reusable collection of tools for agents in scientific research, addressing the need for specialized capabilities beyond general-purpose agent frameworks like LangGraph.

item.title: Archify
item.description: An agent skill for generating verifiable architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams as self-contained HTML. — It allows AI coding agents to produce clear and verifiable visual documentation, which enhances the understanding and communication of complex AI-generated system designs.

item.title: Kith
item.description: Kith generates clinical notes for therapists using AI from ambient session audio. — This tool automates the laborious task of note-taking in clinical settings, streamlining workflows more efficiently than traditional transcription services.

item.title: Speko
item.description: Speko is an 'OpenRouter for Voice AI' platform, providing a unified API to access various voice AI models. — It simplifies integrating voice capabilities by offering a single interface to multiple providers, similar to how OpenRouter aggregates LLM APIs for developers.
